draft_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on most of the six datasets in the tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on most of the six datasets in the tabular suite.
rationale: Ferrule's AUROC exceeds Arbor-GBT on all six datasets (81.6>80.9, 88.3>87.1, 93.7>92.8, 76.4>75.6, 84.9>84.1, 90.2>89.0), which is "most" (indeed all) of the six. No statistical test is claimed, so no significance language is used. Claim is supported and correctly scoped.
